evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: "Notwithstanding these provisions, a Principal/Director may elect not to interview any applicant if the applicant’s most recent annual evaluation rating is neither “effective” nor “highly effective"." (p. 79); "Employees with properly documented performance problems from the present year or employees who are on a CTES District Assistance Plan, or who did not receive an evaluation rating on his/her most recent annual evaluation of “effective” or “highly effective” will not be subject to these UAT procedures and shall not be Unit Adjustment Transferred." (p. 80); "unless the instructional employee’s most recent annual evaluation rating was “effective” or “highly effective"." (p. 87)
